title: Soul-Shot
summary: SOUL-SCOT, SOUL-SHOT noun [soul and scot.] A funeral duty, or money paid by the Romanists in former times for a requiem for the soul.

inlines.v: SOUL-SCOT, SOUL-SHOT noun [soul and scot.] A funeral duty, or money paid by the Romanists in former times for a requiem for the soul.
